summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 58:12 Global Connect CRM Iteration 9 - Staff/Member Self-Service Portal. All 25 backend API tests passed. All frontend portal pages working correctly. Fixed i18n translation key issue for nav.portal.
seed_data_creation: Created test expenses via API testing (TEST_Portal Test Expense 25K UGX, TEST_Portal cash request 100K UGX)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 9 portal features tested and working. Portal backend endpoints at /api/portal/* all functional. Portal frontend pages at /portal/* all rendering correctly. Fixed i18n issue where nav.portal translation key was stored as flat key instead of nested under nav object. Test expenses created during testing are prefixed with TEST_.
